{"action":"shell","command":"cd /testbed && python - << 'EOF'
p = 'tests/test_tagged.py'
s = open(p).read()
old = """    assert c.get('a') == 1
    c.put('c', 3, [])  # evicts LRU entry 'a'"""
new = """    # peek without refreshing recency
    assert c._TaggedCache__data['a'] == 1
    assert c._TaggedCache__tags['a'] == ('old',)
    c.put('c', 3, [])  # evicts LRU entry 'a'"""
assert old in s
s = s.replace(old, new)
old2 = """    c.put('a', 4, [])
    assert c.invalidate('t') == 1
    assert 'a' in c"""
new2 = """    c.put('a', 4, [])
    # reused key carries no stale 't' membership
    assert c.invalidate('t') == 0
    assert 'a' in c"""
assert old2 in s
s = s.replace(old2, new2)
open(p, 'w').write(s)
print('patched')
EOF
PYTHONPATH=src:. python -m pytest tests/test_tagged.py acceptance_public.py -q 2>&1 | tail -4"}
